issue.body:
Instrumenting HTTP endpoints to emit metrics is a fairly common practice, and while automatically doing so via a middleware is not without caveat, it's so convenient that I started doing so ~3-4 years ago (https://steinn.org/post/flask-statsd/) and haven't stopped since.

As I was implementing another hacky middleware like the one described in the post linked above I thought to myself: why not do a proper job of this and package it up for other Starlette (or ASGI) users to enjoy, and skip the hard-coupling with statsd?

The result was this package: https://github.com/steinnes/timing-asgi

I was wondering if this package fits the bill to be included in the starlette list of 3rd party packages, and more than that I'd love to get feedback from other Starlette users on the usefulness, and/or ideas for improvement?

 used these technologies with great success a few years ago (monitoring an API with a couple of thousand req/s) and if the lessons I've learned so far can benefit others, I'd love to discuss and share :-)
issue.title: Include timing-asgi in 3rd party packages
